summary: CreatorOS end-to-end regression — ALL GREEN. Backend: 25/25 pytest passed (10 v1 + 15 v2: auth session/me/logout, dashboard, portfolio GET+POST persistence, finance, goals, content, recommendations, AI chat SSE + history, competitors list/radar/gaps, stripe status shape, youtube 503, strategy generate+list+get via Claude Sonnet 4.5, v1 endpoints compat). Frontend: login screen renders with 'The CEO in your pocket.' + login-google-btn; unauthenticated / redirects to /login. With injected synthetic session token, Dashboard renders (Welcome back Maya, hero score 87 with 4 sub-scores Growth/Financial/Content/Brand 91/84/88/79, 2 alerts including 'YouTube video crossed 400k views', notifications-btn, quick-strategy+quick-competitors cards). ALL 5 TABS work (Home/Portfolio/AI Coach/Finance/Profile). Portfolio shows 7 assets, summary bar ($56.8k rev / $42.3k profit / 74% margin), add-asset-btn present. AI Coach has chat-input, chat-send-btn, chat-reset-btn, Claude Sonnet 4.5 branding shown. Finance shows headline $49.9k, gold line chart, range-1W/1M/3M pills tappable, Profit/Expense/60d Forecast/Runway split cards, recent transactions. Profile shows Maya Chen, Active goals with progress bars, Stripe + YouTube integrations, sign-out-btn. Dashboard quick-strategy navigates to /strategy (horizon-30/60/90 pills + generate-plan-btn present). quick-competitors navigates to /competitors — radar SVG renders cleanly (no red-screen), 'Biggest gaps' section lists Revenue/Audience/Reach/Cadence gap bars, back-btn works. Sign out clears localStorage token and redirects to /login. Previously-broken competitors.tsx orphan block AND dashboard quick-action navigation both confirmed fixed. Only outstanding item is a benign React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning repeated across all screens: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated to style.pointerEvents for react-native-web forward compat. Reference: repeated across (tabs)/* and top-level screens.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: migrate remaining Pressable/View usages of the deprecated `pointerEvents` prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` — silences the recurring RN-web deprecation warning. Grep for `pointerEvents=` in /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src.

OPTIONAL: rotate/remove synthetic UI test session left in Mongo: db.user_sessions.delete_many({session_token:{$regex:'^ui-test-token-'}}); db.users.delete_many({user_id:{$regex:'^user_ui_'}}); db.assets.delete_many({name:{$regex:'^TEST_'}}).
critical_code_review_comments: competitors.tsx: orphan code block that referenced `r` outside its scope has been removed — RadarChart now correctly defines ringPolygon (r=>) and dataPoly (key=>) side by side. No RedScreen on /competitors.

(tabs)/index.tsx: quick-strategy and quick-competitors Pressables now correctly call router.push('/strategy') and router.push('/competitors') with matching testIDs on the interactive element. Verified via UI click → URL change.

backend/server.py: PROJECTION={_id:0} used everywhere, no ObjectId leaks. Async motor throughout. Bearer resolution + TTL index on user_sessions correct. Chat SSE stream includes proper `data: {done:true}` terminator.
auth.py: 401 on missing/invalid token, /logout is idempotent (200 even without header). Session TTL 7 days with Mongo TTL index for auto-cleanup.
integrations.py: Stripe/YouTube gracefully return `connected:false` / 503 respectively when unconfigured — intentional per spec.
strategy.py: strips markdown fences before json.loads, persists str-uuid id, sorts list desc by created_at.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — login, /→/login redirect, dashboard, all 5 tabs, quick-strategy nav, quick-competitors nav, competitors radar, strategy screen, sign-out flow all pass

seed_data_creation: Inserted synthetic UI test session in MongoDB: user_id='user_ui_iter3', session_token='ui-test-token-iter3', email='ui-iter3@test.com', name='Maya Chen'. Plus test_v2_endpoints.py also creates ephemeral users prefixed with user_test_ that self-cleanup in fixture teardown. test_creatoros_api.py creates TEST_Asset_* rows via POST /api/portfolio (persist across runs, safe to leave; cleanup command in action_items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All acceptance criteria met. Backend 25/25 pytest green. Frontend: use synthetic token `ui-test-token-iter3` in localStorage['creatoros_session_token'] to bypass /login and land on tabs (already inserted in Mongo). If token expired, re-run: python3 -c "from pymongo import MongoClient; from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta; import os; from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv('/app/backend/.env'); c=MongoClient(os.environ['MONGO_URL']); db=c[os.environ['DB_NAME']]; now=datetime.now(timezone.utc); db.user_sessions.update_one({'session_token':'ui-test-token-iter3'},{'$set':{'session_token':'ui-test-token-iter3','user_id':'user_ui_iter3','expires_at':now+timedelta(days=1),'created_at':now}},upsert=True)". EXPECTED intentional non-200s: Stripe connected:false (placeholder key), YouTube 503 (no YOUTUBE_API_KEY), /api/auth/me 401 without bearer. Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat/strategy streaming confirmed live.
